The actual mass of a neutron is approximately 1.67e-27 kg, which is very close to the mass of a proton and vastly larger than the mass of an electron (~9.11e-31 kg). Consequently, the Planner's conclusion that the neutron has the least mass is incorrect; the electron is the lightest subatomic particle among the options. This error leads to the wrong final answer.
